description: Enhanced streaming-decode coverage disjoint from the native suite. Drives the incremental decoder over different header shapes: a single-block header with no encryption context, an explicitly empty {} context with framing, and a three-entry encryption context with a longer provider id. In every case the piecewise (byte-at-a-time) decode must reproduce the original byte sequence exactly.
